longDescriptionHtml.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
Welcome to Heritage Haven, a heritage listed 1902 worker's cottage restored with a triangular rear extension of floor to ceiling windows and louvres. Old character meets modern comfort: a queen bedroom with ensuite, a separate guest toilet, an open-air enamel bath, a full kitchen, a restored working wood stove, air conditioning, ceiling fans and two televisions including an Art TV. Off street parking with a 2 m height limit. Walk to the Swan River, ten minutes to the Swan Valley.

The space
Light and bright throughout, with full length windows and louvres to the rear and warm timber floors underfoot. The extension follows the triangular shape of the block and opens north to the garden, so winter light reaches deep into the living area while wide eaves hold off the summer sun. Furnishings are an eclectic mix of period and design pieces that work together beautifully. Outside there is seating, sun lounges, a clothesline and an open-air enamel bath.

Guest access
The property offers easy self check-in. The key is securely stored in a lockbox inside the green box located beside the front door.
Your complete check-in instructions, including the lockbox code, will be sent via the booking platform inbox or email one day before your arrival, so everything you need will be ready before you check in.

Other things to note
ABOUT THE HOUSE
Heritage Haven is heritage listed and sits alongside the historic Midland Junction townsite. It was built in 1902 in the Federation style as a worker's cottage for the Midland Railway Workshops. The architectural extension, completed in 2019 by local architect Patrick Irwin, converted a 1960s carport into the main bedroom and ensuite and added a triangular living wing that follows the shape of the block. It was built with structurally insulated panels, double glazing, thermally broken frames and louvres, so the house holds an even temperature nearly year round.
As the property is close to a busy road we do not recommend children staying in the property.

PARKING:
- Free off-street parking is available in the carport beside the house.
- Please note that the carport has a 2-metre height limit, so larger vehicles such as vans, 4WDs with roof racks, and similar vehicles may not fit. We recommend checking your vehicle’s height before arrival.
- If your vehicle does not fit in the carport, free on-street parking is available along Byers Road.
- For safety and accessibility, please do not park on the footpath in front of the property, as it is regularly used by pedestrians, including people with mobility needs.

ENTRY & SECURITY
- Secure self check-in is available via a lockbox. Full check-in instructions and access details are provided before arrival.
- Smoke alarms are installed throughout the property for your safety.
- Fire blanket is provided in the home.
- First aid kit is available for minor emergencies.
- A noise monitor is installed to monitor noise levels only and help maintain a comfortable environment for guests and neighbours. It does not record conversations.

LIVING & DINING
- Open-plan living and dining area located in the home’s 2019 extension, designed for comfortable everyday living.
- North-facing floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows and doors fill the space with natural light.
- Louvre windows provide excellent cross-ventilation and fresh airflow.
- Warm timber floors add character and a relaxed feel.
- Two televisions, including a stylish Art TV, are available for entertainment.
- Air conditioning and ceiling fans provide year-round comfort
- Restored working wood stove creates a cosy atmosphere on cooler evenings. Firewood can be purchased from a nearby service station.
- A distinctive eclectic mix of period and contemporary designer furniture adds character and personality to the space.


KITCHEN
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Oven and stove
- Dishwasher
- Microwave
- Toaster
- Pod coffee machine.
- Kettle
- Fridge and freezer
- Cookware, crockery, cutlery and glassware for 2 guests
- The Hong Kong Orchid outside the sliding door shades the kitchen through the warmer months

LAUNDRY
- Washing machine only (No Dryer), located outside
- Clothesline
- Iron, ironing board, vacuum and cleaning basics

BEDROOM 1 - MAIN (queen bed, sleeps 2)
- Ensuite bathroom
- Air conditioning and ceiling fan
- The south facing wall was originally shaded by a 100 year old olive tree. The olive has since been replaced with a Chinese Pistache, due to flower for the first time in spring 2026.

OWNER'S PRIVATE ROOM
- One room in the home is locked and reserved for the owner’s private storage and is not accessible to guests.
- All other rooms, living spaces, and outdoor areas are fully available for you to enjoy throughout your stay.

BATHROOMS
- Renovated ensuite attached to the main bedroom.
- Separate guest toilet for added convenience.
- Restored open-air enamel bath outdoors, fully operational and offering a unique bathing experience.
- Towels, bath mats, and hairdryer are provided.
- Starter bathroom amenities are supplied for your arrival.

OUTDOOR
- Private garden on a unique triangular block, featuring a Chinese Pistache and Hong Kong Orchid (Bauhinia) trees.
- Outdoor seating and sun lounges for relaxing and enjoying the garden.
- Restored open-air enamel bath - a genuine one-of-a-kind feature. The bath is positioned in a private outdoor area, with hot water available; comfort may vary with the season and weather.
- Outdoor clothesline for your convenience.
- Outdoor lighting and secure fencing around the property.

CONNECTIVITY & UTILITIES
- Wi-Fi is available throughout the home. Your Wi-Fi network name and password are provided in the check-in instructions sent before your arrival, so you can easily connect when you check in.
- Mains electricity and water are connected and available during your stay.
- Gas connection is also available at the property.

COMFORT CONTROL
- During warmer months, we recommend keeping doors and windows closed during the day to keep the home cool. As temperatures drop in the evening, open the home to enjoy the cool evening and fresh morning air.
- For warmer days when the temperature remains high, air conditioning and ceiling fans are available to help keep you comfortable throughout your stay.

CARE OF THE HOME
This is a heritage listed home, restored with care and furnished with period and design pieces. Please treat the furniture and artwork gently. Any damage is reported to the owner and may be charged in line with the platform's terms.

TOILET CISTERN
- Please do not place cleaning tablets, chemicals, or other products inside the toilet cistern, as these can damage the toilet’s internal components.
